newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Oct/Aug sugar sales higher at 2.55 mln T.
newsitem.headline: German Oct/Aug sugar sales higher at 2.55 mln T.

text.p: German domestic sugar sales in the first eleven months of the 1995/96 (October/September) season were 2.55 million tonnes, up from 2.52 million in October/Aug 1994/95, data from the sugar industry association WVZ showed.
The figures were rounded, whites value.
Sugar sales in August of 236,698 compared with 264,763 in July 1996 and 259,926 in August 1995.
Stocks at the end of August totalled 530,500 tonnes versus 511,072 a year earlier. Carry-in stocks on October 1, 1995 had been 250,854 tonnes (versus 470,689 a year earlier).
August imports of 7,342 tonnes were well below 21,800 a year earlier, and exports of 48,714 tonnes compared with 67,287 in August 1995.
Domestic sugar production in Oct/August 95/96 of 3.82 million tonnes compared with 3.67 million a year earlier.
